added: The Add to program sheet marks a program that already holds the dance, even only as an alternate, with "In this program" (and ×N when it appears more than once), and asks "Add it again?" before adding it a second time. Cancel keeps the sheet open.
"Create a new program with this dance" is now the first row of the Add to program sheet however many programs you have, not only when you have none.

`Program.danceSlotCount` and `Program.danceSlotCountsOf` count the slots holding a dance, alternates included, as the one definition behind the Add to program marker and the program builder's "in program" count.
